In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], a '''raid''' on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on [[Garen IV/Legends|Garen IV]] was enacted by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. In addition to freeing several Rebels, they also freed the disinherited son of the [[Hargeevan royal family]], [[Stevan Makintay]].
